declared_at_utc: see commit (8 October 2026, before its governing run)
declared_by: let us continue this pace of improvement' (8 October 2026). Declaring and the governing run are research; a build under runs/submissions and any upload stay the user's word.
status: DECLARED before its governing run. The procedure is configs/published_means_v2.json's (v47), unchanged except for the control (v72's chain) and the fixed rows (never moved; candidate pm_np also leaves them out of LIRF's means).
disclosure: Exploration read before this declaration (8 October, docs/stack_second inspection and scratch scripts): on the ranking months, v72's predictions minus v2's mapped published means, less v2's method bias (from the v46 stack), read EGLL +2.2 / +8.1 s (January / July, sigma 0.6), LEBL +1.1 / +9.5 (sigma 2.9), LIRF +2.3 / +38.4 (sigma 4.1), LSZH +30.3 (January; u outside the 2025 range, ineligible), LEMD +20.6 (January; sigma 7.1, ineligible), others below their gate. The cells the procedure will select are therefore foreseeable (EGLL both months, LEBL July, LIRF July). The LIRF July 2026 reading was cross-checked against the published daily delay totals: after removing one month-boundary off-block day (2026-06-30, 2 rows against 493 published departures) the implied-delay gap is 18.5 s per row against 4.2-13.4 in the 2025 months. In July 2025 the LIRF population rows raised LIRF's ordinary-row level by about 17 s relative to the non-population rows; candidate pm_np removes them from LIRF's means for that reason. By construction 2025's levels are close to right, so the development read is mainly a no-harm check and cannot meet v57's clauses 2-3; the value lies in the scored months, which no 2025 month can score. A build therefore needs the user's explicit decision.

external_data.name: EUROCONTROL Performance Review Unit, Taxi-Out Additional Time (airport, month)
external_data.terms_and_organiser_statement: as recorded in configs/published_means_v2.json; used on the user's decision of 29 September 2026 ('yes use it')

definitions: configs/published_means_v2.json 'definitions', with the stack = v72's chain: development values = runs/stack_second/dev_table.parquet v71 + sp_hicov7 (0.5 x out-of-month bag, cap 120, floor -12) from runs/stack_second/preds_dev.parquet; ranking = the uploaded runs/submissions/vigorous-whistle_v72.parquet (4280c399...).

candidates.name: pm
candidates.description: v2's procedure verbatim on v72's chain (means over all rows in (0, 7200] s); fixed rows keep their value

candidates.name: pm_np
candidates.description: as pm, but LIRF's label means (2025 mapping), stack means and true level errors use non-fixed rows only (population by its raw rule: LIRF, ADEP_flt null, AIRCRAFT_TYPE_mvt null); other airports as pm

procedure.eligible_cell: u within the fitting months' maximum + 0.02, sigma_a <= 5 s, |level_estimate - bias_a| >= 3 x sigma_a
procedure.shift: every non-fixed prediction in (0, 7200] s of an eligible cell moves by -(level_estimate - bias_a) x max(0, 1 - sigma_a^2 / (level_estimate - bias_a)^2); floor -12 s; every other row unchanged
procedure.method_bias_and_noise: from the development months on v72's development values (mapping without the month read; bias and noise from the other three development months)

rule.primary: configs/published_means_v2.json's rule: accepted when no equal-footing month (2025-01, 2025-07, 2025-12) is worse than v72's development values and their mean change is below zero; among accepted candidates the lower mean.
rule.also_reported: v57's clauses (no month worse than +0.005%, equal-footing mean <= -0.02%, paired-day intervals of January / July / December below zero); expected to fail clauses 2-3 by construction (disclosure).
rule.export: a dry run under runs/published_means_v3/ only; never under runs/submissions without the user's word
